title: Tech Note: Automating Primary Key Generation
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: Still relevant, and specifically useful for pre-v14-era or legacy databases being modernized: the SQL/system-table approach for bulk primary key detection and creation remains valid, though it's a workaround rather than a built-in bulk feature (4D's structure editor still lacks a bulk PK generator).
related_updates: Primary keys remain mandatory for full ORDA/REST functionality, so this kind of bulk-remediation tool remains useful when migrating older databases toward project mode/ORDA.
No new built-in 4D feature has since added bulk primary-key generation to the structure editor, so the SQL-based component approach described here is still a valid technique.
